packageRules.description: Never update this repo's own image. docker-compose.yml must keep tracking the latest tag.

description: Automerge base image updates. pinDigest is the first pin, digest is every bump after.
Do not add minimumReleaseAge here. A digest update carries no timestamp, so the update would be held and never merge.
Never automerge GitHub Action updates. A person must review every one.
These actions run with the Docker Hub token and the GITHUB_TOKEN, so any code they pull in can publish images as us.

Do not replace this review with minimumReleaseAge. It does not work for actions. The github-tags datasource timestamps when a version was first released, not when a tag was re-pushed. If an attacker force-pushes an existing tag to new commits, the digest update ages against the original release date and passes the delay at once.
A delay would therefore postpone every legitimate update and stop none of the attack. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age/
